hana (pm): Proposal: run a 'slabless' pricing experiment. Instead of fixed slabs, customers choose continuous commit % and receive proportional throughput and soft guarantees. Goal: reduce negotiation friction for mid-market.

leo (sales): Customers hate rounding into large slabs. Continuous commit sounds attractive. Need clear docs on what commit levels buy (latency, throughput).

rachel (eng): Implementation: map commit percentage to routing weight and optional reserved tokens. Core work: per-tenant weight in scheduler + billing signal. Est 3 sprints for safe pilot.

troy (finance): Pricing model: charge a monthly commit fee = base * commit%. Also offer an overage rate. Need margin sims for 10/25/50% commits.

emma (legal): Contract caveats: define "commit percent", overage calculation, and change windows. Add safety carveouts for capacity stress.

sam (devex): SDK: expose commit_level in tenant settings + override header for test requests. Docs + migration guide required.

dave (ops): Ops note: soft reserves possible for pilot in us-east-1. For scale, committed capacity contracts required. Need expected QPS from pilot customers.

hana (pm): Launch criteria: 1) scheduler mapping + billing hook, 2) 3 pilot customers, 3) legal addendum, 4) monitoring for cost/latency regressions.

leo (sales): I'll recruit pilots. Prefer 1 mid-market and 2 startups. Will collect traffic patterns.

troy (finance): I'll model the break-even scenarios and share Tues.

emma (legal): I'll draft a short addendum with change windows.

sam (devex): I'll prepare quickstart and sample evals.

dave (ops): Will confirm infra ETA after QPS numbers.

hana (pm): If no vetoes, publish MRD and schedule kickoff Wed 11am PT.
